title: console phone list: card rows draw every shown column as a label / value line — the board's row is the name, one subtitle line and one status chip
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUhKx1XHzkoikGjRB4

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up the seat named in the ACCEPT of PR #28477 (#27058), item 6(b), filed after it landed. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: every reader on a phone (< 768 px) on any grid list or enlarged related tab.

## Observed

On `main` after #27058 (PR #28477), the phone list's card rows (`ObjectGrid`'s mobile cards, #26896) draw the declared name field, then every shown column as its own line, most as 「label … value」 (shot `01` of PR #28477: name, status chip, score, 公司 row, 来源 row; ≈ 290 px per lead). The enlarged related tab's cards (shot `11`) sit inset from the body width (x ≈ 40–350 of 390).

#27058 Target 2 and the board's list frame (`RecordMobile.dc.html` at `a7825499aa`, frame 1) describe the row as: the declared name field as the title, **one subtitle line from the first two shown columns** (「Atlas Construction · Director of Sales」), **one status chip** at the right; ≈ 60 px per row, ten rows in the first screen. #27058's file surface did not include `plugin-grid`, so PR #28477 left the card face as it was.

## Wanted

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid` mobile card row (#26896): title = declared name field; one subtitle line joining the first two shown non-status columns' display values with 「 · 」 (masked / empty values skipped); one status chip (the object's status field, as the desktop row's) at the right; no per-column label lines. A row tap still hands the row to the host's `onRowClick` (pinned by `groupedMobileCards-26896`).
- The enlarged related tab's phone cards use the same face and the body's full width.
- Tests at 390 px; 768 px and up unchanged. Screenshots on `examples/app-crm` against the board's list frame (preview gate, ruling 6520722066).

Links back: #27058, PR #28477, #26896, #26676.
